Definition: Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hashabniah = "whom Jehovah regards"; 1) the father of Hattush, repairer of the wall; 2) a Levite who was among those who officiated at the great fast under Ezra and Nehemiah when the covenant was sealed
